Jonathan (Acme Corp): Hi — sent our accounting team invoice INV-2026-4421 but their AP system is rejecting it due to a currency/amount mismatch. They expect SGD and totals differ by 0.01 SGD after FX conversion. Can you help?
Jamie - Support: Sorry about that, Jonathan. Can you paste the invoice PDF or the invoice metadata (currency, gross, tax)?
Jonathan (Acme Corp): PDF attached in email, but quick metadata: currency: SGD, subtotal: 9,999.99 SGD, tax: 700.00 SGD, total: 10,699.99 SGD. Our AP says the amount on the portal is 10,699.98 SGD.
Omar - Finance: Thanks — that small 0.01 gap screams rounding/FX truncation. Which entity was used to bill — EUR head office or APAC subsidiary?
Jonathan (Acme Corp): It was billed to Acme APAC (SG entity). We selected local currency at checkout.
Sara - Payments: Also, we saw a card decline on initial attempt for the same subscription yesterday, but subsequent reorder succeeded. Could be related if the system retried on a different entity.
Jamie - Support: Pulling invoice from system: INV-2026-4421 -> billed_entity: acme-sg, invoice_currency: SGD, currency_conversion: true, fx_rate: 1.0000 (stored), charge_items: [{"code":"svc-std","amount":9999.99},{"tax":700.00}] total_stored: 10699.98
Jonathan (Acme Corp): That's odd — PDF totals 10699.99.
Raj - Eng Billing: I see where this can happen. Our FX branch currently stores two paths: a) canonical USD internal units then convert and round per-line to local currency, b) previously we rounded at invoice-level. If different paths were used for PDF generation vs portal rendering, you can get 0.01 diffs.
Omar - Finance: Is there an audit trail? invoice_history/logs?
BillingBot: Invoice INV-2026-4421 — generated 2026-11-02T09:11:33Z, pdf_render_path=pdf-v2, portal_amount_calc=portal-v1, fx_rate_snapshot=1.001234
Sara - Payments: Also confirm whether retry used a different payment_method_id — that could have caused the card network to route under a different entity. We had cases where gateway tokenization linked to the EUR entity.
Jamie - Support: Repro steps I recommend for eng: 1) fetch invoice by id and dump raw line items + stored fx snapshot 2) run both calc paths locally: `./billing calc-invoice --id INV-2026-4421 --path portal-v1` and `--path pdf-v2` 3) compare per-line rounding and final sum.
Raj - Eng Billing: I'll run the two paths now. If it's a path mismatch we should: a) backfill portal to use canonical rounding (hotfix) b) create a migration to normalize existing invoices and issue corrected PDFs/credit notes when discrepancy > 0.00.
Omar - Finance: For Acme APAC this is sensitive — their AP will reject automated payments. Let's prepare a credit note for 0.01 SGD and flag it as non-revenue adjustment. Jamie, can you offer a temporary manual credit and reissue PDF?
Jamie - Support: Yep — I can generate a manual credit and reissue. Need approval from finance. Approving now.
Omar - Finance: Approved. Please tag the invoice and add note: `manual_credit 0.01 SGD issued to reconcile PDF portal mismatch`
Jonathan (Acme Corp): Thank you — can you also confirm whether this will affect tax reporting? Our auditors will ask.
Omar - Finance: This micro-adjustment won't change tax for the period (below rounding threshold) but we'll include a reconciliation memo.
Raj - Eng Billing: Quick update — reproduced locally. portal-v1 does `floor(line_amount * 100)/100` per item then sum, pdf-v2 does `round(line_amount,2)` per item. On certain last-digit combinations that creates a 0.01 gap. I'll push a patch to unify to bankers rounding at both paths.
Sara - Payments: Regarding the card decline, I traced the initial decline txn to gateway token `gtok_3X` tied to acme-eu entity; subsequent attempt used `gtok_4Y` tied to acme-sg. Noting for reconciliation.
Jamie - Support: Action items: - Raj to roll patch to unify rounding (priority: high) - Omar to approve/record manual credit and reissue PDF - Sara to reconcile declined txn and mark payment attempts on invoice thread - Jamie to send reconciled invoice and credit note to Jonathan
Jonathan (Acme Corp): Appreciated — timeline?
Raj - Eng Billing: Patch + release to staging within 2 hours, hotfix to prod within 24h if no regressions.
Omar - Finance: Manual credit and PDF out within 30m.
Jamie - Support: Sent credit note and corrected PDF to Jonathan (Acme) — invoice now shows 10,699.99 SGD on portal. Please confirm receipt. :thumbsup:
Jonathan (Acme Corp): Got it. Thanks everyone.
Raj - Eng Billing: Following up: will open a postmortem ticket and a data-migration task to find invoices with portal-pdf mismatches > 0.00 and auto-generate credits where appropriate.
Omar - Finance: Marking this as P1 for multi-entity billing inconsistencies and creating a short runbook for support to handle similar AP rejections.
BillingBot: Ticket created: BIL-1429 (multi-entity round mismatch) assigned to eng-billing, priority: high
Jamie - Support: Closing thread for now — reopen if anything else shows up. :white_check_mark:
